'When this hits, put it into your soul and draw 2 cards.' + printed **Dominate** / **Phantasm**. Light Illusionist Action - Attack (ArmoryDeckLegendsPrism).

PRINTED KEYWORDS NOT AUTHORED: Dominate and Phantasm are in printed_keywords and fire from the card DB keywords field; re-authoring either would be a defect.

SOUL PLACEMENT: TRIGGERED ON_HIT -> PUT_SELF_IN_ZONE zone 'soul'. Handler read this session (effect_types.py:1618-1639): it takes zone/to_zone/destination (default 'soul' for this spelling) and routes through canonical put_object, so the move emits proper events. Mandatory per official_release_notes 4 ('you must put it into your hero's soul ... not optional') - hence a bare effect, outside any MAY.

DEVIATION FROM THE TRIAGE LIST, deliberate and verified: it named MOVE_REF to_zone SOUL. MOVE_REF reads a ref register (its 'ref' param) and nothing in this ability stores the attack card into one - the triage route would read an unset ref. PUT_SELF_IN_ZONE is the proven sibling spelling for this exact sentence family (.drafts/herald_of_rebirth_yellow.json and _blue.json use it for the same 'when this hits, put it into your soul' clause).

DRAW: amount 2, player omitted (SELF default = controller). Handler read this session (effect_types.py:1222-1249): reads amount/player, resolves via effect_draw.

EFFECT ORDER follows the printing: soul placement first, then the draw.

Release notes 1-3 (combat chain does not close; Phantasm stops functioning as a triggered ability once in the soul; last-known-information go again still pays the action point) are engine-side consequences of the mid-chain zone move, not authorable in JSON.
